first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: green soccer field
entities.identification: The green grass playing field covering the middle and lower portions of the image, with the halfway line, center circle, and penalty-area markings at the left end visible.

entities.name: sideline advertising barrier
entities.identification: The long advertising facilities arranged continuously along the outer edge of the field in front of the stands.

entities.name: group of players in green clothing
entities.identification: The group of players on the field wearing green shirts and shorts and white knee-high socks, excluding Person D and Person E.

entities.name: group of players in dark clothing
entities.identification: The group of players on the field wearing shirts with alternating blue and dark colors, dark shorts, and soccer socks.

entities.name: Person D
entities.identification: The person inside the penalty area at the left end, in front of Object D, wearing a bright orange shirt and bottoms.

entities.name: Person E
entities.identification: The person on the field wearing a bright yellow shirt and black shorts, moving with play from near the center circle.

entities.name: soccer ball
entities.identification: The small white nearly spherical object moving with play on the grass.

entities.name: Object D
entities.identification: The goal at the left end behind Person D, with white goalposts, a crossbar, and light-colored netting.

entities.name: gray tiered stands
entities.identification: The gray stepped seating and passageway structure extending across the upper and upper-left portions of the image.

entities.name: group of spectators in the stands
entities.identification: The distant group of spectators gathered in the seats in the upper-middle and right portions of the image.

entities.name: off-field group of people in vests
entities.identification: The scattered group of people near the outer edge of the field wearing bright yellow upper garments and dark bottoms, excluding Person E on the field.

entities.name: off-field gray rigid passageway
entities.identification: The gray strip of ground between the lower edge of the stands and the sideline advertising facilities.

entities.name: white advertising surface beyond the end line
entities.identification: The low-positioned, white-background advertising surfaces on both sides of Object D, beyond the end line and close to the field, bearing text.
